name: 20261101-ppo-v8-history-ranked-fixedlr
rollout_storage: lossless packed RAM: float32 numerics, packed binary flags, uint16 card IDs
evaluation_policy: 1 scripted + protected latest generation x2 + four retained historical generations x1; bind by locked development ranking; learner sampled/greedy 64 games each at PPO0/50/100; stochastic strict decrease selects best; independent initial/best/final sampled/greedy 128 games each
precision: BF16 neural forwards; FP32 probabilities, GAE, losses, weights, gradients and Adam
budget_definition: 100 PPO iterations x 131072 fresh learner samples; at most 16 Adam updates per PPO; epoch=1

model_retention_policy.selection: fixed mixed stochastic val mean placement; earliest wins ties
model_retention_policy.after_evaluation: retain timestamped stage best after initial/best/final heldout evaluations; preserve V1/V2 opponents and every inherited source checkpoint
model_retention_policy.records: W&B scalars, exact opponent hashes and precision, config, evaluations, cleanup manifest

stage_initialization: Continue actual previous-stage selected best including Adam; fresh local counters; constant LR1e-5
opponents: 1 scripted + protected latest generation x2 + four retained historical generations x1; bind by locked development ranking + 1 learner; rotate physical seats every game
sampling_description: arbitrary named frozen-policy groups, batched separately by policy; all sampling no_grad; learner-only recomputation and backward during PPO
learning_rate_description: constant 1e-5 for every Adam update; equal linear endpoints; no warmup or decay
